en: A black‑and‑white harbor scene showing a busy quay with several steamships and smaller boats moored along the pier. People, early automobiles, and horse‑drawn carts move along a cobblestone waterfront with tram tracks. Across the wide river or harbor are shipyards with large cranes and industrial facilities. On the left hillside a prominent church or cathedral with a tall tower dominates the skyline. On the right, a large building by the water bears the word "GÖTAVERKEN," and one of the closer ships is labeled "GOTA." In the lower‑right corner is a circular printer's mark that reads "ÄKTA FOTO" with stylized initials in the center.
